notes:
Third release candidate for 2.2.0, for playtesting. Foundry v14, PF2e or SF2e.

Everything in rc.2, plus:

New

  • M-13 Raptor (ME Weapons): level 3 semi-automatic sniper rifle; light, fast, ten-round heat sink. Mystaria (stage II) now carries one.
  • Barla Von (ME NPCs → Notable Figures): the Presidium's volus financial adviser and Shadow Broker agent. He sells answers about anything on the Citadel.
  • Harkin (ME NPCs → Citadel & Council): the disgraced ex-C-Sec officer drinking in Chora's Den, who sells leads for the price of a drink.

Fixed

  • C-Sec officers showed the wrong face. The seven C-Sec statblocks (and Barla Von) would have appeared on the canvas as the Human Soldier. They now show a placeholder until their art is ready.

Please test

The rc.1 and rc.2 checklists still apply. Also drop Barla Von, Harkin and a C-Sec officer on a scene and check each shows its own token.
